## Owner assertions

- [ ] Inputs are immutable originals or their provenance is recorded.
- [ ] `expected.bin` came from the named independent reference process.
- [ ] Tool identity/hash and ordered command are exact.
- [ ] Allowed read/write/diff ranges were reviewed as half-open ranges.
- [ ] The expected output SHA-256 is approved.
- [ ] Any alias states the exact shared fact and workflow/mode scope.
- [ ] Runtime/support promotion scope is explicit; blank means no promotion.
